The fog hugs the ground and the world is consumed,

all humanity eclipsed by the moon.

(Don't worry we'll meet soon...)

The howls lose momentum as stone walls barricade.

Vacant memories of the freaks parade.

Our surroundings were so happy in the light of day.

I waited for hours now uneasy in place,

the dirt pulls me under to see skull to face.

Crying! Crying! All I hear is crying!

The hurtful and mourning words, unlike those gone, now flying.

Breath the cold air in exchange for raw blood.

Given away for any kind of love.

Your face once glowed, now covered in clovers and willows.

Reminiscent of the night, breathing through pillows.

Crown the burden instead of bury.

The consequence of this choice was many.

Your absence of presence, now your conscience resents itself as in control.

You lost your chance, and under no circumstance, will this half become a whole.
